title.description: Heading rendered above the list. HTML is allowed (DOMPurify-sanitised).

itemTitle.description: Nunjucks template rendered per row as the collapsed panel header. The row's fields are the template context, plus `_index` (0-based). HTML is allowed. Falls back to `Item N` when absent or when the render is empty.

accordion.description: Only one panel may be open at a time.

defaultExpandAll.description: Expand every row on first render. Otherwise rows start collapsed (newly added rows open automatically).

deferCollapse.description: Don't close a row on the user's click — instead fire `onCollapse` and leave it open, so config can validate first and close it via the `collapseItem` method only when valid. Enables validate-before-collapse without a collapse-then-reopen flicker.

addItemButton.description: Ant Design Button props for the add button (e.g. `title`, `icon`, `type`).

removeItemIcon.description: Icon props for the per-row remove icon (defaults to AiOutlineMinusCircle).

minItems.description: Minimum number of rows; the list auto-seeds empty rows up to this count and hides remove below it.
